purpose: Train and select three full GeometryAnchoredSpatialEventEncoder seeds to test whether explicit causal polar geometry improves observable spatial-event set prediction over sealed exclusive, frozen-encoder-set and nonlearning baselines.

approval.scope: One bounded implementation smoke followed by one immutable three-seed C01-C08 joint capacity run; zero C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner access.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed automatic best-choice execution without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 five-frame organized 16x720 LiDAR dataset.
Sealed old exclusive single-center, frozen-encoder set and nonlearning geometry development baselines.

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Each seed visits every C01-C06 observation once per epoch for 8 epochs. World order and within-world row order are deterministic per seed/epoch. No row deletion or resampling. Train-only circular roll is one uniformly sampled integer 2-degree polar-bin shift with identical robot-relative xyz rotation.

teacher.source: Observable Teacher V2: native-mesh LOS terminal/junction targets intersected only with fixed LiDAR vertical FOV.
teacher.valid_mask: event_mask; padding type/identity -1 and zero xyz; all zero-event rows retained.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Deployment receives only robot-relative tokens, descriptor/confidence/uncertainty. Teacher identity is used only by the supervised descriptor loss; graph nodes remain provisional and edges remain execution-verified.
teacher.student_input: Only five causal range_m and valid_mask frames.

split.fit: C01-C06 supplies every gradient plus presence/type frequency weights.
split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: C07-C08 selects minimum total set-loss epoch and maximum-F1 confidence from the fixed 0.05:0.05:0.95 grid.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Formal command binds only C01-C08 dataset/Teacher/baseline hashes. Quarantined historical C09 field-shape exposure and all C09 values contribute no training, threshold, architecture or result.

model.optimizer: AdamW lr=3e-4 weight_decay=1e-4, gradient norm cap=5
model.normalization: Fixed physical range divide by 50m inside model; no fitted normalization statistics.
model.augmentation: Uniform circular roll over 180 integer polar bins, train-only, no tuned magnitude.

acceptance.matching: Same event type and one-to-one 3D error <=4m on all C07-C08 rows.
acceptance.failure_policy: If any seed fails, stop before graph; do not tune epochs, loss, query count, threshold grid, Teacher or planner.

estimated_cost.compute: Three sequential RTX 5090 joint trainings; smoke first measures exact throughput and memory before spec freeze.
